issues.detail: The Greek 'παρεχομενος' (present active participle) indicates an ongoing state or action of 'presenting' or 'offering' oneself. The Vietnamese translation uses the imperative 'hãy tỏ ra' (let/must show), which changes the grammatical mood from a descriptive participle to a command.
The Vietnamese adds the word 'con' (I/me) which is not present in the Greek text; the Greek focuses on the action of presenting oneself as a model.
